page_title: PAN 0-2 ENG | Panama v England 27/06/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Abdulrahman Al Jassim has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' A pass from Ollie Watkins (England) is intercepted by Orlando Mosquera and the move breaks down.
90+5' Jordan Henderson (England) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
90+4' Eberechi Eze (England) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for England.
90+4' A cross from a corner kick by Panama is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
90+1' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Jose Fajardo Nelson (Panama) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
90+1' Noni Madueke (England) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Orlando Mosquera.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Ismael Diaz (Panama) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the right-hand post.
88' Thomas Christiansen has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Eric Davis (Panama) replacing Jorge Gutierrez.
88' Substitution. Carlos Harvey makes way for Alberto Quintero (Panama).
87' Marcus Rashford (England) decides to try his luck with a first-time bullet of a shot. Unfortunately for him, he doesn't hit the ball perfectly and his effort ends well wide of the left post.
86' Jordan Henderson (England) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
84' Thomas Tuchel has decided to make a change. Ollie Watkins (England) replaces Harry Kane.
84' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jordan Henderson (England) comes onto the pitch so that Elliot Anderson can be given a rest.
84' Andres Andrade (Panama) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
81' Marcus Rashford (England) is flagged for offside.
78' Djed Spence (England) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
78' The linesman signals that Ismael Diaz (Panama) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
76' Ismael Diaz (Panama) leans back and sends a volley soaring over the bar from inside the box.
76' The ball goes out of play. Panama are awarded a corner kick.
74' Ismael Diaz (Panama) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes way over the bar.
74' Azarias Londono (Panama) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
71' Substitution. Jose Rodriguez walks off the pitch and Azarias Londono (Panama) comes on as a substitute.
71' Thomas Tuchel has decided to substitute Jude Bellingham and he is replaced by Eberechi Eze (England).
71' The manager makes a subsitution with Ismael Diaz (Panama) coming on for Yoel Barcenas.
69' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
67' 0 - 2 It's a goal! Harry Kane (England) bursts into the box to get on the end of a whipped in cross from Jude Bellingham and scores magnificently from close range into the roof of the net. 0:2.
66' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Harry Kane (England) inside the box following a slide rule pass.

64' Ambitious effort from Michael Murillo (Panama). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the left post.
63' Thomas Tuchel decides to make a substitution. Bukayo Saka will be replaced by Noni Madueke (England).
63' Substitution. Djed Spence (England) in, Jarell Quansah out.

62' 0 - 1 Bukayo Saka produces a cross from the resulting corner and finds Jude Bellingham (England) inside the box. He pulls the trigger and scores, sending the ball inside the left post. What a brilliant finish. 0:1.
60' Jarell Quansah (England) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
60' Abdulrahman Al Jassim shows a yellow card to Jarell Quansah (England) for a tough tackle.
59' Corner kick. England will have an opportunity.
59' Jude Bellingham (England) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
58' Abdulrahman Al Jassim blows his whistle and it's Marcus Rashford (England) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
57' Harry Kane (England) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the middle of the goal. However, Orlando Mosquera anticipates the shot and makes a decent save.
56' Jose Rodriguez (Panama) finds himself unmarked on the edge of the box, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
55' A great run from Marcus Rashford (England) ends with a shot inside the box that flashes just past the left post.
53' Jose Fajardo Nelson (Panama) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
52' The referee blows his whistle after Harry Kane (England) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.
50' Marcus Rashford (England) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
49' The game is interrupted now, Christian Martinez (Panama) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
46' Half-time substitution. Tomas Rodriguez is replaced by Jose Fajardo Nelson (Panama).
46' The whistle blows and Abdulrahman Al Jassim starts the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' What a chance to score from the free kick by Marcus Rashford (England). He unleashed a sharp shot that sailed just wide of the right post.

45+1' Carlos Harvey (Panama) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Abdulrahman Al Jassim with no other option than to blow for a foul. England are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Harry Kane (England) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
43' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Bukayo Saka (England). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
43' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Bukayo Saka (England). The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to England.
41' Bukayo Saka (England) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
39' Flag goes up against Morgan Rogers (England) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
38' What a wasted chance that is! A precise cross into the box found Marcus Rashford (England), whose header floated just over the bar.
36' Jude Bellingham (England) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
35' Elliot Anderson (England) has time on the edge of the box. His shot is disappointing, though, as it flies towards the middle of the goal where Orlando Mosquera makes a comfortable save.
34' Michael Murillo (Panama) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
33' Nico O'Reilly (England) is ready on the edge of the six-yard box and duly receives the cross, but his header fizzes just wide of the left post.
31' Bukayo Saka (England) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
30' Marcus Rashford (England) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Orlando Mosquera, who smothers the ball.
30' Marcus Rashford (England) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
28' Close! Carlos Harvey (Panama) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post.
27' Yoel Barcenas (Panama) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

26' Jose Rodriguez (Panama) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the left side of the goal. It's a great effort but an even better save from Jordan Pickford, who tips the ball around the post. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Panama.
23' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
22' Bukayo Saka (England) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
22' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Jude Bellingham (England) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well wide of the right post.
21' Michael Murillo (Panama) serves up a nice cross, but Jordan Pickford punches the ball away.
19' Bukayo Saka (England) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
19' Marcus Rashford (England) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
18' The corner from Elliot Anderson (England) is cleared away by the defence.
17' Harry Kane (England) receives the ball inside the box from the resulting free kick, but fails to score as his shot is blocked by one of the defenders. Good work from England as they win a corner.
17' Dangerous play by Fidel Escobar (Panama). Abdulrahman Al Jassim blows his whistle for a foul. England will take a free kick.
16' Jose Rodriguez (Panama) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
15' The attempt by Bukayo Saka (England) isn't very precise and Orlando Mosquera stops it with ease.
14' Bukayo Saka (England) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
11' Christian Martinez (Panama) brings an opponent down and Abdulrahman Al Jassim interrupts the game.
10' The goalkeeper pulls off a save to deny Ezri Konsa (England), whose low effort is only aimed at the middle of the goal.
10' England take a short corner kick.
10' Marcus Rashford (England) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The linesman makes the right call and England will have a corner.
8' Bukayo Saka (England) wins the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar.
8' The ball is out of play and England manage to earn a corner.
8' Marcus Rashford (England) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Orlando Mosquera has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
7' Referee Abdulrahman Al Jassim sees the trip by Tomas Rodriguez (Panama) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
5' The resulting corner from Elliot Anderson (England) is cleared.

5' Jude Bellingham (England) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception. Now England have a corner.
4' Bukayo Saka (England) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
3' Jorge Gutierrez (Panama) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Abdulrahman Al Jassim blows his whistle for a foul.
1' Tomas Rodriguez (Panama) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Jordan Pickford.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Panama will have the kick-off.
Abdulrahman Al Jassim is introduced as the referee for today's match.
